title: 040 follow-up: do the auxiliary heads rank NNMT's OWN operating-point trades (mt_lr_ri_g24)? -- the 'skip the entry when momentum/flow/risk/regime/profit is predicted bad' gate
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26). Committed before any head score is attached to any mt_lr_ri_g24 trade. The screen reads the EARLY half only (f00-f07); the late half of the trade-level relation stays unread for any arm that follows (the late P&L of mt_lr_ri_g24 itself has been read: the arm's late half is not blind). Screens can only ELIMINATE; a pass earns a P&L arm, nothing more.
why: user request 2026-10-26. 040 §9 screened the heads on the WIDTH BOOK's 412 trades (relevance FAIL, all five), not on the trades the NNMT model takes itself at its operating point, which is the book an NNMT entry gate would act on.

population.trades: every pooled trade of plan_mt_lr_ri_g24 (seed 1, legacy windows) in f00-f07 (evaluation.pool); expected 3731
population.outcome: pp = 100 * profit_ratio (per-trade return in %, stake-independent: the gate decides which entries happen, not their size)
population.signal_bar: open_date - 15 min (the candle whose enter_long opened the trade)
population.instrument: key_of(NNMT_LR_RI_G24) == key_of(NNMT_LR_RI) (the MT_LR_RI_fNN signal tables are the g24 arm's model outputs); every trade's signal bar has enter_long == 1 in MT_LR_RI_fNN (share >= 0.995); early count == 3731. Any failure: INCONCLUSIVE, no score read.

regime.why_source: weight 0 in the deployed model: its regime head is untrained (own-head skill margin -0.15 / -0.12, heads_descriptive_mt_lr_ri.json); the _ah model's passed skill (§9)

risk.why_source: the deployed model's own trained head (skill +0.23 / +0.23)

profit.why_source: weight 0 in the deployed model (own skill -0.22 / -0.20); the _ah model's passed skill (§9)

descriptive: the same five columns from the OTHER source (MT_LR_RI_AH for risk/momentum/flow; own MT_LR_RI for regime/profit), and the trading head's own p_buy (direction +), reported with no verdict

relevance_rule.score: the head column at the trade's signal bar, multiplied by -1 for direction '-'
relevance_rule.gap_bottom20: PRIMARY: within each fold, mean pp of the trades above that fold's 20th percentile of score minus mean pp of the trades at or below it; pooled as the trade-weighted mean over folds (the gate's question: are the trades it would skip worse?)
relevance_rule.p_value: one-sided fold-stratified permutation test of gap_bottom20 (scores shuffled within fold), 10,000 permutations, numpy default_rng(0)
relevance_rule.partial: Spearman partial correlation of score with pp given bb_width, pooled, and per fold (sign_folds = folds sharing the pooled sign)
relevance_rule.pass: gap_bottom20 > 0 AND p_value <= 0.01 (0.05 / 5 heads, Bonferroni) AND partial > 0 AND sign_folds >= 5 of 8, in the declared direction
relevance_rule.reported: gap_share50 (top half minus bottom half, within fold), coverage, rho with the model's p_buy

arm.name: hd_<head>_g24
arm.spec: mt_lr_ri_g24 + an entry veto: no entry when the head score (declared direction) is below the fold's threshold; nothing else changes (model key asserted == NNMT_LR_RI's)
arm.threshold: per fold, one process each: the 20th percentile of the score over the bars of that fold's validation tail (training data the weights never fit, as research.control_sizer.pick) where the model's entry fires (enter_long == 1), 4 dp; --verify: the regenerated fold class loads the stored threshold and vetoes exactly the bars below it
arm.judge: research.nnnc_switches.judge.judge_one(hd_<head>_g24, mt_lr_ri_g24): early gain > 0, late gain > 0, paired not WORSENED, risk not WORSENED (maps as preregistration_screens.json); INCONCLUSIVE if no fold changed
arm.seed: a PASS is re-run on seed 2 (vs mt_lr_ri_g24_s2, thresholds re-picked at seed 2); every margin > 0 on both seeds
arm.only_if: the head passes the relevance rule; a failing head is recorded with no arm

seen_before: 040 §9: all five heads relevance FAIL on the 412 width-book trades (momentum +0.000, risk +0.001, regime +0.006, profit +0.009, flow -0.039)
pre-040 single windows: apply_task_filters (3-of-4 head vote) -14.2 pp on the old network

amendments.after: the screen (screens_heads_own.json: profit@MT_LR_RI_AH PASS) and the DESCRIPTIVE bad-class look (heads_own_badclass_descriptive.json: -P(neutral) rho 0.69 with atr_pct_roll, 0.56 with bb_width)
amendments.what: (1) a model-free twin arm hd_atr_g24; (2) the head is credited only if hd_profit_g24 also beats the twin; (3) the live path of the profit veto: the second model runs in-process; (4) the veto column is fixed as registered (p_profit_profit, '+'); P(neutral) is NOT substituted (it was found after the screen).
amendments.why: user request 2026-10-26: the profit head's ranking looks like predicted move SIZE (volatility). If a single model-free indicator vetoes as well, the second model adds nothing.

hd_profit_g24.class: NNMT_LR_RI_G24_HDP = HeadVetoMixin over NNMT_LR_RI_G24: no entry when MT_LR_RI_AH's %p_profit_profit at the bar < the fold's threshold
hd_profit_g24.live_path: the veto model (the MT_LR_RI_AH class of the same fold / seed; NNMT_LR_RI_AH on a mainline class) is loaded through StrategyResolver-equivalent construction inside the strategy and run on the same raw candles in populate_indicators, so backtest, dry and live compute it the same way; it never trains (its weights must already exist, else ModelMissing)
hd_profit_g24.threshold: as registered: the 20th percentile of %p_profit_profit over the bars of the fold's validation tail where the trading model's entry fires (enter_long == 1, veto off), 4 dp
hd_profit_g24.instrument: model key of NNMT_LR_RI_G24_HDP == NNMT_LR_RI's; the in-strategy %p_profit_profit equals the MT_LR_RI_AH_fNN signal table at every mt_lr_ri_g24 entry bar of the test window (abs diff <= 1e-5 on >= 99.9% of bars); --verify: every test-window entry has score >= threshold and every vetoed bar has score < threshold

hd_atr_g24.class: NNMT_LR_RI_G24_ATRV = the same HeadVetoMixin with the model-free column atr_pct_roll (the strategy's own indicator), no second model
hd_atr_g24.threshold: the 20th percentile of atr_pct_roll over the same validation-tail entry bars, 6 dp
hd_atr_g24.judge: judge_one(hd_atr_g24, mt_lr_ri_g24) -- its own verdict (a model-free NNMT entry filter)

rule.hd_profit_g24: PASS (PROVISIONAL) only if judge_one(hd_profit_g24, mt_lr_ri_g24) PASS AND judge_one(hd_profit_g24, hd_atr_g24) PASS; if it passes the first but not the second: 'gain is volatility' (the head is not credited)
rule.seed_2: any PASS is repeated at seed 2 before it is reported as a result: hd_atr_g24 on mt_lr_ri_g24_s2's weights (no training); hd_profit_g24 also needs MT_LR_RI_AH seed-2 weights (15 trainings, one at a time); thresholds re-picked at seed 2; every margin > 0 on both seeds

amendments.reported_beside: DESCRIPTIVE: cs_aro_tr, w_free; trades vetoed per fold; the overlap of the two arms' vetoed entries
